review.assessment: The paired host samplers corroborate sustained saturation; process snapshots attribute substantial concurrent CPU to mds, mds_stores, and mdworker_shared. This supports indexing as a plausible disposable-runner environmental contributor, not as a proven cause on the two earlier expired runs or proof the proposed change repairs readiness.

observations: The only change in c7887ebd is an inline workflow step immediately before the first readiness check.
The step requires RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=github-hosted and RUNNER_OS=macOS before sudo mdutil; self-hosted and non-macOS runs fail closed.
The step is not exposed as a local helper or called by normal local workflow code; the workflow itself runs only by workflow_dispatch.
It changes indexing only on that disposable hosted runner, checks status, and has no process kills, trustd/security setting changes, or user-Mac mutation path.
Existing readiness checks, resource guard limits, concurrency group, and artifact provenance steps are unchanged in the reviewed diff.
scope_review.status_check: Requires at least one Indexing disabled status and rejects any Indexing enabled status; command failures abort under set -euo pipefail.

notes: The evidence establishes correlation on the diagnostic VM; process CPU uses its own sampling interval and does not provide exact accounting for the paired host samples.
Static review cannot verify mdutil behavior, readiness recovery, or the acceptance path on a fresh hosted VM.
This review does not assert a Settings result, D87 closure, native Chromium launch result, or Store artifact replacement.

required_next_evidence: One authorized GitHub-hosted acceptance run must show indexing status verification, pass the existing readiness gates, and produce the selected case's native acceptance evidence before calling the environment repair verified.
